info.title: PackProof isolated R&D API
info.description: Additive research API only; production API remains backend/openapi.json. All findings are governed by server flags, authorization, explicit consent, immutable committed sources and qualification gates. An accepted asynchronous job can later fail/abstain. Parameter shape validation does not establish source dimensions, physical association, consent, qualification or cryptographic validity. No deployment authorization is granted.

200.description: Successful research operation; no release or physical qualification is implied.

BearerAuth.description: Existing PackProof authenticated session; access remains scoped to the caller and Proof. Admin endpoints additionally require system administrator role.

SidecarChunkInput.description: 262144-byte chunks. partCount must equal ceil(byteLength/262144); every decoded chunk must have the exact expected length. Receipt is bound to the sealed native inventory.

items.description: Versioned research record; inspect schemaVersion or the feature envelope before interpreting feature-specific fields.

AnalysisRequest.description: Only client-accepted parameters are exposed. Canonical parameters are limited to 32768 characters. Sources must already be committed, authorized and collectively <=128 MiB. Model paths, scores, policies, challenges and qualification are resolved by the server.
